test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The lion was chasing the stag behind the bush.

options.text: The stag had been chased by the lion behind the bush.
The stag was chased by the lion behind the bush.
The stag was being chased by the lion behind the bush.
The stag is being chased by the lion behind the bush.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**The stag was being chased by the lion behind the bush.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice is used when the subject of the sentence is being acted upon by the verb.
 
• To form the passive voice, use the auxiliary verb "**to be**" with the past participle form of the main verb.
 
• In this sentence, "**lion**" is the subject and "**chasing**" is the verb.
 
• To make it passive, we need to make "**stag**" the subject and use the past participle form of "**chase**".
 
• Therefore, "**was being chased**" is the correct passive form of the sentence. 

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.
